study type: Interrupted Time Series (ITS) study, retrospective review
cohort: The study included 2,451 pregnant women admitted in labour and monitored using either the modified WHO Partograph or the WHO Labour Care Guide at St. Francis Hospital Nsambya.
finding: The implementation of the WHO Labour Care Guide was associated with a significant decrease in urgent caesarean section rates (0.80, p-value = 0.016) immediately after its introduction.
mod_finding: The Labour Care Guide accounted for a 14.0% risk difference and an odds ratio of 0.44 for urgent caesarean section deliveries, demonstrating a significant reduction in this mode of birth.
